critical_findings.title: All backend failures collapse to HTTP 502; typed error taxonomy discarded
critical_findings.fix: Map errors.As classes (R2ValidationError->400, R2AuthError->401, R2NotFoundError->404, R2QuotaError->429, default 502) and return structured {error, code} bodies

critical_findings.title: --json mode fails silently on configuration errors
critical_findings.fix: Emit printErrorJSON envelope before os.Exit(1) when JSONOutput is set; add regression test

critical_findings.title: Error responses mix text/plain and JSON content types
critical_findings.fix: Use writeJSONStatus for all daemon error paths; set Content-Type in DevServer handlers (dev.go:161)

critical_findings.title: No HTTP method enforcement on daemon routes
critical_findings.fix: Wrap handlers with a GET-only guard returning 405 + Allow header

critical_findings.title: MCP server hardcodes version 1.0.0 and pins protocol version without negotiation
critical_findings.fix: Make serverInfo.version injectable via NewMCPServer option; echo client-requested protocolVersion when supported

critical_findings.title: Non-constant-time token compare; empty configured token authenticates
critical_findings.fix: Use crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare; reject empty Config.Token in New; add ReadHeaderTimeout to http.Server

critical_findings.title: ZoneService.Get classifies every error as not-found
critical_findings.fix: Inspect wrapped status; map only 404 to R2NotFoundError; stop reusing Bucket/Key fields for zones

critical_findings.title: R2 bucket list truncates at first page
critical_findings.fix: Loop with the pagination cursor (cloudflare-go v0.116 ListR2Buckets is single-page) and return ListResult[*Bucket]

critical_findings.title: Legacy r2go2 prefix leaks into public error strings and package doc
critical_findings.fix: Change format prefix to cosmoflare: and fix the package doc in types.go:2

critical_findings.title: SSE channel is lossy with no replay on reconnect
critical_findings.fix: Retain last frame per channel and replay as first frame on subscribe

recommendations.action: Map library error classes to HTTP statuses in withCloudflare
Emit OutputResponse JSON envelope in PersistentPreRun error path
Add GET-only method guard with 405 to daemon routes
Constant-time token compare and empty-token rejection in server.New
Inject AppVersion into MCP serverInfo and negotiate protocol version
Serve all error paths as application/json across daemon and dev server
Publish OpenAPI 3.1 spec for daemon REST + SSE channels
Add protocol_version to serve handshake JSON and document compat policy

roadmap_suggestions.title: Daemon error contract v2
roadmap_suggestions.description: Structured {error, code} bodies with status mapping from the existing error taxonomy so the desktop app can branch on failure class

roadmap_suggestions.title: Versioned daemon API
roadmap_suggestions.description: /v1/ prefix or handshake protocol_version field plus documented shell/daemon skew policy

roadmap_suggestions.title: OpenAPI spec for serve daemon
roadmap_suggestions.description: Machine-readable contract for 6 REST endpoints and 3 SSE channels; enables generated TS clients for the desktop app

roadmap_suggestions.title: MCP version SSOT and protocol negotiation
roadmap_suggestions.description: Wire AppVersion into serverInfo; support client-requested protocol versions

roadmap_suggestions.title: SSE last-frame replay
roadmap_suggestions.description: Retain newest frame per channel and replay on subscribe so reconnecting clients converge without waiting for next poll
